verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents custom rule creation, fraud-trend analytics and sandbox test cards, but nothing about backtesting or simulating a rule against historical traffic to see what it would have blocked, flagged or cost. Fraud insights and test cards are adjacent features, not rule backtesting, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can backtest a rule against my historical traffic before deploying it, seeing exactly what it would have blocked, flagged, and cost
